films.title: The Scent of the Night
films.overview: A former policeman turns full-time robber and goes on a downward spiral of crime in 1970s Rome.

films.title: Toxic Love
films.overview: The alienating and repetitive life of a group of heroin junkies in 1980s Rome.

films.title: Don't Be Bad
films.overview: A story set in the 90s and in the outskirts of Rome to Ostia. A world where money, luxury cars, night clubs, cocaine and synthetic drugs are easy to run. A world in which Vittorio and Cesare, in their early twenties, act in search of their success.
